meta.source: BLAZE CAMP MASTER MODEL (raw/MASTER_MODEL.xlsx) tabs 'EXAMPLE UPPERLOWER SPLIT', 'EXAMPLE PUSHPULLLEGS SPLIT', 'EXAMPLE FAT BURNBODY TONING PRO'
meta.counting_convention: working set = 1.0 to each prime mover, 0.5 to clear synergists; warm-up cardio and steady-cardio days excluded; A-drills counted as AP_SPRINT athletic sets; KB Book openers as CT_CORE_THORAX control set

muscle_mapping.prime_mover_source: coach PURPOSE labels in BYOP 'PUSHPULLLEGS - 3 or 6 DAYS A WK' ('Quads','Hamstring','Quads/Glutes','Hamstring/Glutes','Chest','Chest/Shoulders','Back','Shoulders/Traps','Bicep','Tricep'); synergists inferred

meta.rep_notation: date cells with number_format m/d are 'N/N' reps per side; 'MAX REPS'/'MAX' = AMRAP; 'NN secs' = timed circuit station
